text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaaaay!
Hey, hey, listen, listen!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Guess what? I'm gonna hold a wedding!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: —So basically! An alumna big sister is having her wedding here, and I get to help out!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And that's not all, that's not all!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text:
This academy is where it all started for me...
As I embark on this new chapter of my life,
I wanted to take my new start right here.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text: And you know! Watching you try your hardest as a Muse to bring excitement to everyone, Urara-chan, made me think.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Alumna
text_block_list.text: If you could help me, I know for sure it would make for a wonderful new beginning!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that amazing!?
Urara was specially requested!
I gotta do my absolute best!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...But I don't really know what makes a "wonderful wedding."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So, I'm going around asking everyone!
I'll do my best for the big sister!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you want a wonderful wedding, it's gotta be super lovey-dovey!
Like skydiving and hugging mid-air~♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I see! Zooming down from the sky!
So that's what makes a wonderful wedding!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And then exchanging vows at a seaside chapel.
Right then, someone stands up yelling, "Stop the wedding!" and professes their true love...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...If you'd like, I can lend you a few shoujo manga that have scenes like that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
An orchestra playing, riding in a carriage to greet everyone.
A traditional style like that is truly wonderful too, don't you think?♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A dramatic climax is brilliant too!
Channeling the power of love into a special move, launching it skyward—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, Haru Urara dashed all around the academy gathering ideas for a "wonderful wedding"...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san from earlier!
Hey, hey, I came up with the wedding plan!
choice_data_list: What did you come up with?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: First, all our friends will skydive from the sky!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then we plunge into the ocean!
Then we greet everybody while listening to traditional music!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And just as the vows are being spoken—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Someone shouts, "HOLD IT RIGHT THEEEEERE!" and professes their true love!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then!
Pouring all the power of love, they fire a special ultimate move~~

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And blast off into outer space!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think!?
choice_data_list: I-I feel like a lot of things are off...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmmmm, I guess so.
To be honest, I kind of felt that way too.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I asked so many people, but planning a wonderful wedding is really hard.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's definitely because I haven't asked enough people!
I'll go ask even more people!
I have to do my best for that big sister!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Ikuno-chan, Karen-chan!
Look, I'm planning a wedding, and—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ummm, anyway, I gotta do my best—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaa!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I rushed over in a panic to help the fallen Haru Urara, but...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh, wedding, wedding...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She stood right back up on her own and walked away, muttering to herself...
